Title: Can you use Gathii's and/or Bolesław's abilities when you dont need stealth?

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
Can you use Gathii's and/or Bolesław's abilities when you don't need stealth?

They seem to be worded in a way, that the first sentence is the "main effetct" (in Bolesław's case cost and effect) and after the Period, in the sentence is a rider effect, depended on the main effect.

Similarly like "khabar: community" doesnt stop you form bleeding, because you dont need stealth at this point, but Bleeds now have stealth.

Gathii

Anarch: During an Action Gathii performs, you can reveal the top card of your library. If this is a Master card, he burns 1 blood; otherwise he gets +1 stealth.

Bolesław Gutowski

Anarch: During an action he performs, Bolesław can burn 1 blood to reveal the top card of your crypt and then shuffle your crypt. If the revealed card is a copy of Bolesław, Bolesław gets +1 stealth for this action; otherwise, he gets +1 strength for this action.

Messages.Author: Draud
Messages.Body: Since it doesn't tell you "even when it's not needed" you can't perform the ability because rules prohibit the posibility of doing something you can't acomplish.

Messages.Body:

The text of the cards follows the "during x, do y" format where "y" isnt prohibited and have a secondary conditional effect "z" related to what "y" was that could result in a potentially prohibited effect....as the played effect isnt prohibited it should be playable and similar to playing Vast Wealth, that could result in that the first equipment found is not useable and would be burned/not equipped, the effect "z" if prohibited would just be lost.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Ankha can we have an official answer please, thanks.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Can you use Gathii's and/or Bolesław's abilities when you don't need stealth?
> They seem to be worded in a way, that the first sentence is the "main effetct" (in Bolesław's case cost and effect) and after the Period, in the sentence is a rider effect, depended on the main effect.
>
You can use it anytime, but you don't gain the stealth if you don't need it. From the rulebook: "Stealth can be added during an action only when needed, that is, only if the action is currently being blocked and the blocking minion has enough intercept to block the acting minion."

This is because the outcome of the coin flip is not known, so you can use the effect. And if you would gain stealth but the condition "if the action is currently being blocked and the blocking minion has enough intercept to block the acting minion" is not met, then you don't get stealth (since stealth can't be added in that case). See also ruling about The Portrait: groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/AhLw5v3abjU/m/L4d8Qv_C2osJ

The +1 strength effect always work since there's no restriction about gaining strength during an action.

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Similarly like "khabar: community" doesnt stop you form bleeding, because you dont need stealth at this point, but Bleeds now have stealth.
>
The difference is that the Khabar: Community doesn't provide temporary stealth for the current action. See also the ruling about superior Repulsion: groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/TinQ8ywzIHU/m/-zW_hcYbiD4J

So the safe way to use its ability is to trigger it when you are being blocked if you're trying to get stealth.
